text: In the beginning was the Word.
The same was in the beginning with God.
All things were made by him.

And it came to pass in those days that a decree went out, and all the people were counted, each in his own city, according to the word which had been spoken by the prophets of old, so that the saying might be fulfilled which was written concerning the appointed time.
And the light shineth in darkness.
And the third day there was a marriage.
